versos.grego: Καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ ἐλθεῖν αὐτὸν εἰς οἶκόν τινος τῶν ἀρχόντων τῶν Φαρισαίων σαββάτῳ φαγεῖν ἄρτον, καὶ αὐτοὶ ἦσαν παρατηρούμενοι αὐτόν.

controles.web: When he went into the house of one of the rulers of the Pharisees on a Sabbath to eat bread, they were watching him.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, as he went into the house of one of the chief Pharisees to eat bread on the sabbath day, that they watched him.
controles.livre: E aconteceu que, entrando ele num sábado para comer pão na casa de um dos chefes dos fariseus, eles estavam o observando.

versos.grego: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἄνθρωπός τις ἦν ὑδρωπικὸς ἔμπροσθεν αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: Behold, a certain man who had dropsy was in front of him.
controles.kjv: And, behold, there was a certain man before him which had the dropsy.
controles.livre: E eis que um certo homem com o corpo inchado estava ali diante dele.

versos.grego: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν πρὸς τοὺς νομικοὺς καὶ Φαρισαίους λέγων Ἔξεστιν τῷ σαββάτῳ θεραπεῦσαι ἢ οὔ;

controles.web: Jesus, answering, spoke to the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?”
controles.kjv: And Jesus answering spake unto the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath day?
controles.livre: E respondendo Jesus, falou aos estudiosos da Lei, e aos fariseus, dizendo: É lícito curar no sábado?

versos.grego: οἱ δὲ ἡσύχασαν. καὶ ἐπιλαβόμενος ἰάσατο αὐτὸν καὶ ἀπέλυσεν.

controles.web: But they were silent.   He took him, and healed him, and let him go.
controles.kjv: And they held their peace. And he took him, and healed him, and let him go;
controles.livre: Porém eles ficaram calados; e ele, tomando -o ,o curou, e o despediu.

versos.grego: καὶ πρὸς αὐτοὺς εἶπεν Τίνος ὑμῶν υἱὸς ἢ βοῦς εἰς φρέαρ πεσεῖται, καὶ οὐκ εὐθέως ἀνασπάσει αὐτὸν ἐν ἡμέρᾳ τοῦ σαββάτου;

controles.web: He answered them, “Which of you, if your sonor an ox fell into a well, wouldn’t immediately pull him out on a Sabbath day?”
controles.kjv: And answered them, saying, Which of you shall have an ass or an ox fallen into a pit, and will not straightway pull him out on the sabbath day?
controles.livre: E ele, respondendo-lhes, disse: De qual que vós cairá o jumento, ou o boi em algum poço que, mesmo no sábado, não o tire logo?

versos.grego: καὶ οὐκ ἴσχυσαν ἀνταποκριθῆναι πρὸς ταῦτα.

controles.web: They couldn’t answer him regarding these things.
controles.kjv: And they could not answer him again to these things.
controles.livre: E nada podiam lhe responder a estas coisas.

versos.grego: Ἔλεγεν δὲ πρὸς τοὺς κεκλημένους παραβολήν, ἐπέχων πῶς τὰς πρωτοκλισίας ἐξελέγοντο, λέγων πρὸς αὐτούς

controles.web: He spoke a parable to those who were invited, when he noticed how they chose the best seats, and said to them,
controles.kjv: And he put forth a parable to those which were bidden, when he marked how they chose out the chief rooms; saying unto them,
controles.livre: E vendo como os convidados escolhiam os primeiros assentos, disse-lhes uma parábola:

versos.grego: Ὅταν κληθῇς ὑπό τινος εἰς γάμους, μὴ κατακλιθῇς εἰς τὴν πρωτοκλισίαν, μή ποτε ἐντιμότερός σου ᾖ κεκλημένος ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ,

controles.web: “When you are invited by anyone to a marriage feast, don’t sit in the best seat, since perhaps someone more honorable than you might be invited by him,
controles.kjv: When thou art bidden of any man to a wedding, sit not down in the highest room; lest a more honourable man than thou be bidden of him;
controles.livre: Quando fores convidados para o casamento de alguém, não te sentes no primeiro assento, para que não aconteça de se outro convidado mais digno que tu estiver,

versos.grego: καὶ ἐλθὼν ὁ σὲ καὶ αὐτὸν καλέσας ἐρεῖ σοι Δὸς τούτῳ τόπον, καὶ τότε ἄρξῃ μετὰ αἰσχύνης τὸν ἔσχατον τόπον κατέχειν.

controles.web: and he who invited both of you would come and tell you, ‘Make room for this person.’ Then you would begin, with shame, to take the lowest place.
controles.kjv: And he that bade thee and him come and say to thee, Give this man place; and thou begin with shame to take the lowest room.
controles.livre: E venha o que convidou a ti e a ele, e te diga: Dá lugar a este; E então, com vergonha, tenhas que tomar o último lugar.

versos.grego: ἀλλ’ ὅταν κληθῇς, πορευθεὶς ἀνάπεσε εἰς τὸν ἔσχατον τόπον, ἵνα ὅταν ἔλθῃ ὁ κεκληκώς σε ἐρεῖ σοι Φίλε, προσανάβηθι ἀνώτερον· τότε ἔσται σοι δόξα ἐνώπιον πάντων τῶν συνανακειμένων σοι.

controles.web: But when you are invited, go and sit in the lowest place, so that when he who invited you comes, he may tell you, ‘Friend, move up higher.’ Then you will be honored in the presence of all who sit at the table with you.
controles.kjv: But when thou art bidden, go and sit down in the lowest room; that when he that bade thee cometh, he may say unto thee, Friend, go up higher: then shalt thou have worship in the presence of them that sit at meat with thee.
controles.livre: Mas quando fores convidado, vai, e senta-te no último lugar; para que quando vier o que te convidou, te diga: Amigo, sobe para este assento melhor. Então terás honra diante dos que estiverem sentados contigo à mesa .

versos.grego: ὅτι πᾶς ὁ ὑψῶν ἑαυτὸν ταπεινωθήσεται, καὶ ὁ ταπεινῶν ἑαυτὸν ὑψωθήσεται.

controles.web: For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.”
controles.kjv: For whosoever exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.
controles.livre: Porque qualquer que exaltar a si mesmo, e aquele que humilhar a si mesmo, será exaltado.

versos.grego: Ἔλεγεν δὲ καὶ τῷ κεκληκότι αὐτόν Ὅταν ποιῇς ἄριστον ἢ δεῖπνον, μὴ φώνει τοὺς φίλους σου μηδὲ τοὺς ἀδελφούς σου μηδὲ τοὺς συγγενεῖς σου μηδὲ γείτονας πλουσίους, μή ποτε καὶ αὐτοὶ ἀντικαλέσωσίν σε καὶ γένηται ἀνταπόδομά σοι.

controles.web: He also said to the one who had invited him, “When you make a dinner or a supper, don’t call your friends, nor your brothers, nor your kinsmen, nor rich neighbors, or perhaps they might also return the favor, and pay you back.
controles.kjv: Then said he also to him that bade him, When thou makest a dinner or a supper, call not thy friends, nor thy brethren, neither thy kinsmen, nor thy rich neighbours; lest they also bid thee again, and a recompence be made thee.
controles.livre: E dizia também ao que tinha lhe convidado: Quando fizeres um jantar, ou uma ceia, não chames a teus amigos, nem a teus irmãos, nem a teus parentes, nem a teus vizinhos ricos, para que eles também em algum tempo não te convidem de volta, e tu sejas recompensado.

versos.grego: ἀλλ’ ὅταν δοχὴν ποιῇς, κάλει πτωχούς, ἀναπήρους, χωλούς, τυφλούς·

controles.web: But when you make a feast, ask the poor, the maimed, the lame, or the blind;
controles.kjv: But when thou makest a feast, call the poor, the maimed, the lame, the blind:
controles.livre: Mas quando fizeres convite, chama aos pobres, aleijados, mancos e cegos.

versos.grego: καὶ μακάριος ἔσῃ, ὅτι οὐκ ἔχουσιν ἀνταποδοῦναί σοι· ἀνταποδοθήσεται γάρ σοι ἐν τῇ ἀναστάσει τῶν δικαίων.

controles.web: and you will be blessed, because they don’t have the resources to repay you. For you will be repaid in the resurrection of the righteous.”
controles.kjv: And thou shalt be blessed; for they cannot recompense thee: for thou shalt be recompensed at the resurrection of the just.
controles.livre: E serás bem-aventurado, porque não eles não têm como te recompensar; pois tu serás recompensado na ressurreição dos justos.

versos.grego: Ἀκούσας δέ τις τῶν συνανακειμένων ταῦτα εἶπεν αὐτῷ Μακάριος ὅστις φάγεται ἄρτον ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τοῦ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: When one of those who sat at the table with him heard these things, he said to him, “Blessed is he who will feast in the Kingdom of God!”
controles.kjv: And when one of them that sat at meat with him heard these things, he said unto him, Blessed is he that shall eat bread in the kingdom of God.
controles.livre: E um dos que juntamente estavam sentados à mesa ,ouvindo isto, disse-lhe: Bem-aventurado aquele que comer pão no Reino de Deus.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ἄνθρωπός τις ἐποίει δεῖπνον μέγα, καὶ ἐκάλεσεν πολλούς,

controles.web: But he said to him, “A certain man made a great supper, and he invited many people.
controles.kjv: Then said he unto him, A certain man made a great supper, and bade many:
controles.livre: Porém ele lhe disse: Um certo homem fez um grande jantar, e convidou a muitos.

versos.grego: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν τὸν δοῦλον αὐτοῦ τῇ ὥρᾳ τοῦ δείπνου εἰπεῖν τοῖς κεκλημένοις Ἔρχεσθε, ὅτι ἤδη ἕτοιμά ἐστιν.

controles.web: He sent out his servant at supper time to tell those who were invited, ‘Come, for everything is ready now.’
controles.kjv: And sent his servant at supper time to say to them that were bidden, Come; for all things are now ready.
controles.livre: E na hora do jantar, mandou seu servo para dizer aos convidados: Vinde, que tudo já está preparado.

versos.grego: καὶ ἤρξαντο ἀπὸ μιᾶς πάντες παραιτεῖσθαι. ὁ πρῶτος εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ἀγρὸν ἠγόρασα, καὶ ἔχω ἀνάγκην ἐξελθὼν ἰδεῖν αὐτόν· ἐρωτῶ σε, ἔχε με παρῃτημένον.

controles.web: They all as one began to make excuses.   “The first said to him, ‘I have bought a field, and I must go and see it. Please have me excused.’
controles.kjv: And they all with one consent began to make excuse. The first said unto him, I have bought a piece of ground, and I must needs go and see it: I pray thee have me excused.
controles.livre: E cada um deles todos começou a dar desculpas. O primeiro lhe disse: Comprei um campo, e tenho que ir vê-lo; peço-te desculpas.

versos.grego: καὶ ἕτερος εἶπεν Ζεύγη βοῶν ἠγόρασα πέντε, καὶ πορεύομαι δοκιμάσαι αὐτά· ἐρωτῶ σε, ἔχε με παρῃτημένον.

controles.web: “Another said, ‘I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I must go try them out. Please have me excused.’
controles.kjv: And another said, I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I go to prove them: I pray thee have me excused.
controles.livre: E outro disse: Comprei cinco pares de bois, e vou testá-los; peço-te desculpas.

versos.grego: καὶ ἕτερος εἶπεν Γυναῖκα ἔγημα, καὶ διὰ τοῦτο οὐ δύναμαι ἐλθεῖν.

controles.web: “Another said, ‘I have married a wife, and therefore I can’t come.’
controles.kjv: And another said, I have married a wife, and therefore I cannot come.
controles.livre: E outro disse: Casei-me com uma mulher, e portanto não posso vir.

versos.grego: καὶ παραγενόμενος ὁ δοῦλος ἀπήγγειλεν τῷ κυρίῳ αὐτοῦ ταῦτα. τότε ὀργισθεὶς ὁ οἰκοδεσπότης εἶπεν τῷ δούλῳ αὐτοῦ Ἔξελθε ταχέως εἰς τὰς πλατείας καὶ ῥύμας τῆς πόλεως, καὶ τοὺς πτωχοὺς καὶ ἀναπήρους καὶ τυφλοὺς καὶ χωλοὺς εἰσάγαγε ὧδε.

controles.web: “That servant came, and told his lord these things. Then the master of the house, being angry, said to his servant, ‘Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in the poor, maimed, blind, and lame.’
controles.kjv: So that servant came, and shewed his lord these things. Then the master of the house being angry said to his servant, Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in hither the poor, and the maimed, and the halt, and the blind.
controles.livre: E aquele servo, ao voltar, anunciou estas coisas a seu senhor. Então o chefe da casa, irritado, disse a seu servo: Sai depressa pelas ruas e praças da cidade, e traze aqui aos pobres, e aleijados, e mancos e cegos.

versos.grego: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ δοῦλος Κύριε, γέγονεν ὃ ἐπέταξας, καὶ ἔτι τόπος ἐστίν.

controles.web: “The servant said, ‘Lord, it is done as you commanded, and there is still room.’
controles.kjv: And the servant said, Lord, it is done as thou hast commanded, and yet there is room.
controles.livre: E o servo disse: Senhor, está feito como mandaste, e ainda há lugar.

versos.grego: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ κύριος πρὸς τὸν δοῦλον Ἔξελθε εἰς τὰς ὁδοὺς καὶ φραγμοὺς καὶ ἀνάγκασον εἰσελθεῖν, ἵνα γεμισθῇ μου ὁ οἶκος·

controles.web: “The lord said to the servant, ‘Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled.
controles.kjv: And the lord said unto the servant, Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled.
controles.livre: E o senhor disse ao servo: Sai pelos caminhos, e trilhas, e força-os a entrar, para que minha casa se encha.

versos.grego: λέγω γὰρ ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐδεὶς τῶν ἀνδρῶν ἐκείνων τῶν κεκλημένων γεύσεταί μου τοῦ δείπνου.

controles.web: For I tell you that none of those men who were invited will taste of my supper.’”
controles.kjv: For I say unto you, That none of those men which were bidden shall taste of my supper.
controles.livre: Porque eu vos digo, que nenhum daqueles homens que foram convidados experimentará da minha ceia.

versos.grego: Συνεπορεύοντο δὲ αὐτῷ ὄχλοι πολλοί, καὶ στραφεὶς εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς

controles.web: Now great multitudes were going with him. He turned and said to them,
controles.kjv: And there went great multitudes with him: and he turned, and said unto them,
controles.livre: E muitas multidões iam com ele; e virando-se, disse-lhes:

versos.grego: Εἴ τις ἔρχεται πρός με καὶ οὐ μισεῖ τὸν πατέρα αὐτοῦ καὶ τὴν μητέρα καὶ τὴν γυναῖκα καὶ τὰ τέκνα καὶ τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς καὶ τὰς ἀδελφάς, ἔτι τε καὶ τὴν ψυχὴν ἑαυτοῦ, οὐ δύναται εἶναί μου μαθητής.

controles.web: “If anyone comes to me, and doesn’t disregardhis own father, mother, wife, children, brothers, and sisters, yes, and his own life also, he can’t be my disciple.
controles.kjv: If any man come to me, and hate not his father, and mother, and wife, and children, and brethren, and sisters, yea, and his own life also, he cannot be my disciple.
controles.livre: Se alguém vier a mim, e não odiar a seu pai, e mãe, e mulher, e filhos, e irmãos, e irmãs, e ainda também sua própria vida, não pode ser meu discípulo.

versos.grego: ὅστις οὐ βαστάζει τὸν σταυρὸν ἑαυτοῦ καὶ ἔρχεται ὀπίσω μου, οὐ δύναται εἶναί μου μαθητής.

controles.web: Whoever doesn’t bear his own cross, and come after me, can’t be my disciple.
controles.kjv: And whosoever doth not bear his cross, and come after me, cannot be my disciple.
controles.livre: E qualquer que não levar sua cruz, e vier após mim, não pode ser meu discípulo.

versos.grego: Τίς γὰρ ἐξ ὑμῶν θέλων πύργον οἰκοδομῆσαι οὐχὶ πρῶτον καθίσας ψηφίζει τὴν δαπάνην, εἰ ἔχει εἰς ἀπαρτισμόν;

controles.web: For which of you, desiring to build a tower, doesn’t first sit down and count the cost, to see if he has enough to complete it?
controles.kjv: For which of you, intending to build a tower, sitteth not down first, and counteth the cost, whether he have sufficient to finish it?
controles.livre: Porque qual de vós, querendo edificar uma torre, não se senta primeiro para fazer as contas dos gastos, para ver se tem o suficiente para a completar?

versos.grego: ἵνα μή ποτε θέντος αὐτοῦ θεμέλιον καὶ μὴ ἰσχύοντος ἐκτελέσαι πάντες οἱ θεωροῦντες ἄρξωνται αὐτῷ ἐμπαίζειν

controles.web: Or perhaps, when he has laid a foundation, and is not able to finish, everyone who sees begins to mock him,
controles.kjv: Lest haply, after he hath laid the foundation, and is not able to finish it, all that behold it begin to mock him,
controles.livre: Para que não aconteça que, depois de ter posto seu fundamento, e não podendo a completar, comecem a escarnecer dele todos os que o virem,

versos.grego: λέγοντες ὅτι Οὗτος ὁ ἄνθρωπος ἤρξατο οἰκοδομεῖν καὶ οὐκ ἴσχυσεν ἐκτελέσαι.

controles.web: saying, ‘This man began to build, and wasn’t able to finish.’
controles.kjv: Saying, This man began to build, and was not able to finish.
controles.livre: Dizendo: Este homem começou a construir, e não pôde terminar.

versos.grego: Ἢ τίς βασιλεὺς πορευόμενος ἑτέρῳ βασιλεῖ συμβαλεῖν εἰς πόλεμον οὐχὶ καθίσας πρῶτον βουλεύσεται εἰ δυνατός ἐστιν ἐν δέκα χιλιάσιν ὑπαντῆσαι τῷ μετὰ εἴκοσι χιλιάδων ἐρχομένῳ ἐπ’ αὐτόν;

controles.web: Or what king, as he goes to encounter another king in war, will not sit down first and consider whether he is able with ten thousand to meet him who comes against him with twenty thousand?
controles.kjv: Or what king, going to make war against another king, sitteth not down first, and consulteth whether he be able with ten thousand to meet him that cometh against him with twenty thousand?
controles.livre: Ou qual rei, indo a guerra para lutar contra outro rei, não se senta primeiro para consultar, se pode ir ao encontro com dez mil soldados ,vindo contra ele vinte mil?

versos.grego: εἰ δὲ μήγε, ἔτι αὐτοῦ πόρρω ὄντος πρεσβείαν ἀποστείλας ἐρωτᾷ τὰ πρὸς εἰρήνην.

controles.web: Or else, while the other is yet a great way off, he sends an envoy, and asks for conditions of peace.
controles.kjv: Or else, while the other is yet a great way off, he sendeth an ambassage, and desireth conditions of peace.
controles.livre: Se não puder ,estando o outro ainda longe, manda -lhe representantes diplomáticos, e roga pela paz.

versos.grego: οὕτως οὖν πᾶς ἐξ ὑμῶν ὃς οὐκ ἀποτάσσεται πᾶσιν τοῖς ἑαυτοῦ ὑπάρχουσιν οὐ δύναται εἶναί μου μαθητής.

controles.web: So therefore whoever of you who doesn’t renounce all that he has, he can’t be my disciple.
controles.kjv: So likewise, whosoever he be of you that forsaketh not all that he hath, he cannot be my disciple.
controles.livre: Assim, portanto, qualquer de vós que não renuncia a tudo, não pode ser meu discípulo.

versos.grego: Καλὸν οὖν τὸ ἅλας· ἐὰν δὲ καὶ τὸ ἅλας μωρανθῇ, ἐν τίνι ἀρτυθήσεται;

controles.web: Salt is good, but if the salt becomes flat and tasteless, with what do you season it?
controles.kjv: Salt is good: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be seasoned?
controles.livre: Bom é o sal; porém se o sal perder o sabor, com o que ele será temperado?

versos.grego: οὔτε εἰς γῆν οὔτε εἰς κοπρίαν εὔθετόν ἐστιν· ἔξω βάλλουσιν αὐτό. ὁ ἔχων ὦτα ἀκούειν ἀκουέτω.

controles.web: It is fit neither for the soil nor for the manure pile. It is thrown out. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”
controles.kjv: It is neither fit for the land, nor yet for the dunghill; but men cast it out. He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
controles.livre: Nem para a terra, nem para adubo serve; lançam-no fora. Quem tem ouvidos para ouvir, ouça.
